dedupe_keys.name: un sdg global database and api infrastructure related indicator series electricity access water sanitation mobile coverage disaster losses

description: The United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD) maintains the Global SDG Indicators Database, which holds the official country, regional and global series used to monitor the Sustainable Development Goals, with a data portal and a public JSON API. The API's series list read today (release 2026.Q2.G.02) has 713 series. Many concern infrastructure and services: access to electricity by urban and rural population, installed renewable generating capacity per person, reliance on clean cooking fuels, safely managed and basic drinking water and sanitation, safely treated wastewater, water stress and water use efficiency, reservoir and lake water area, the rural population within 2 km of an all-season road, freight and passenger volumes by mode and maritime freight loaded and unloaded, 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G mobile network coverage and fixed broadband subscriptions, schools with electricity, water and internet, public-private partnership commitments and official flows for infrastructure, and the Sendai disaster series on damaged critical infrastructure, disrupted basic services and damaged health and education facilities. Coverage: global, by country and region; years vary by series. Format and access: data portal and REST API returning JSON (series list, data by series and area); free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): UN terms of use: personal, non-commercial use (no separate open licence found on the SDG portal). Caveats: only the series list was read; values, years and country coverage of each series were not checked, and the data are compiled from custodian agencies such as the WHO/UNICEF JMP and ITU. Simulation uses: national baselines of service access, network coverage and disaster impacts on infrastructure for global comparison and scenario calibration. Related records: the WHO/UNICEF JMP database (data-who-unicef-jmp-wash-database), ITU ICT statistics (data-itu-ict-statistics) and DesInventar Sendai (data-desinventar-sendai).
